page_title: ANG 0-2 MAR | Angers v Marseille 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Bilal Nadir (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+4' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) dribbles into the box, but Geronimo Rulli is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
90+4' Good clearance! Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
90+1' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
88' Pierrick Capelle (Angers) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
85' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
83' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Florent Hanin and he is replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Esteban Lepaul walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ibrahima Niane (Angers).
80' One of the players from Angers times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
77' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
77' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) takes the corner.
75' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Pierrick Capelle (Angers) replaces Jean-Eudes Aholou.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Amar Dedic (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Amine Gouiri.
75' Substitution. Mason Greenwood is replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
74' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Amine Gouiri picks out Neal Maupay (Marseille) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 0:2.
72' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Angers get a free kick.
71' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

69' 0 - 1 Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
69' Marseille win a corner.
68' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
67' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Angers was in an offside position.
65' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is replacing Ismael Bennacer.
65' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Angers.
64' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
63' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to intercept.
62' The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.

62' Luis Henrique (Marseille) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
60' Surely that's handball by one of the Angers players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
59' Here is a change. Quentin Merlin is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Neal Maupay (Marseille).
58' What a huge chance for Quentin Merlin (Marseille). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.

58' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.

57' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Yahia Fofana tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
56' An accurate cross picks out Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
55' Here comes a substitution. Farid El Melali is given a rest as he is replaced by Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
55' Alexandre Dujeux is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Haris Belkebla suffers an injury and Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) comes on.
54' Haris Belkebla (Angers) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

54' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yahia Fofana.
52' A player from Marseille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
50' One of the Angers players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
48' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
48' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) is booked for saying more than Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem was willing to tolerate.
47' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Yahia Fofana. This effort really didn't trouble him.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
44' Michael Murillo (Marseille) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
41' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle as Farid El Melali (Angers) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
38' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
37' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
36' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
35' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
33' Jim Allevinah (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Luis Henrique (Marseille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' The free kick from long range, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' A player from Marseille brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Angers are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
27' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

26' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
24' A pass by Mason Greenwood (Marseille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
22' Goal, no wait. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for handball and Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
21' The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.

20' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
18' Farid El Melali (Angers) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
15' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
14' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
13' The ball has crossed the sideline. Angers are taking a throw-in.
12' Michael Murillo (Marseille) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
11' Luis Henrique (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
8' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
6' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for an infringement. Angers are awarded the free kick.
5' Great teamplay by Angers as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the corner but it's cleared.
2' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
2' Farid El Melali (Angers) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

1' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Angers win a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Angers will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
